data.body: `end_time` is recomputed via `ensure_end_after_start(info.start_time, info.end_time)` here, but it was already computed identically a few lines above (right after the matching-start check) and used for the `_note_parent_end` calls. `info` is a frozen dataclass, so neither input can have changed in between, making this a redundant recomputation. It's harmless today but is dead code that risks silently diverging from the first computation on a future edit (e.g. someone updates only one of the two call sites). Delete this line and reuse the `end_time` already in scope.
